subject: MdeModulePkg: Don't Allow Guard Pages to Cross Bin Boundaries
reasons: Complex algorithmic bug fix that changes the AdjustMemoryS() API signature from pass-by-value to pass-by-pointer (IN to IN OUT), adds new logic for tracking guard page placement, and updates all callers
While the API signature change (IN UINT64 Start -> IN OUT UINT64 *Start) affects multiple parameters and one call site, it is a targeted fix requiring deep understanding of heap guard semantics
The broader change involves restructuring the function body with new variables, new conditions, and changed logic — not a purely mechanical transformation
Single conceptual fix in a small cluster of related files; no series of similar changes across packages
